1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    53	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    54	EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
    55	CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
    56	DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
    57	CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
    58	# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
    59	# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
    60	SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
    61	
    62	SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
    63	CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
    64	DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
    65	
    66	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    67	die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    68	
    69	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    70	  case "$1" in
    71	    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
    82	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
    83	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    84	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
    89	case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
    90	[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
    91	[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
    92	[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
    93	[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
    94	[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
    95	for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    96	
    97	SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
    98	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    99	TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
   100	
   101	IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
   102	IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
   103	[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
   104	[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
   105	for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
   106	  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
   107	  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
   108	    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
   109	done
   110	for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   111	  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
   112	  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
   113	  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
   114	  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
   115	  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
   116	        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
   117	    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
   118	  fi
   119	done
   120	
   121	SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
   122	  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
   123	SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
   124	WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
   125	
   126	[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
   127	[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
   128	SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
   129	BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
   130	
   131	# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}
   157	CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
   158	
   159	# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
   160	PLAN=()
   161	for t in $(seq 1 "$TRIALS"); do
   162	  for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   163	    for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do PLAN+=("$a|$f|$t"); done
   164	  done
   165	done
   166	
   167	json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }
   168	
   169	write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
   170	  local out="$1" dry="$2" claude_bin="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" cli_version
   171	  cli_version="$("$claude_bin" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unknown)"
   172	  local harness_commit harness_dirty=false
   173	  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
   174	  [[ -n "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain -- evals/harness evals/graders evals/suites evals/tasks 2>/dev/null)" ]] && harness_dirty=true
   175	  local per_trial
   176	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-${FIXTURES[0]}.yaml")"
   177	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
   178	  jq -n \
   179	    --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg batch "$BATCH" \
   180	    --arg source_commit "$SRC_FULL" --arg source_worktree "$WORKTREE" \
   181	    --arg harness_commit "$harness_commit" --argjson harness_dirty "$harness_dirty" \
   182	    --arg model_id "$MODEL" --arg cli "$claude_bin" --arg cli_version "$cli_version" \
   183	    --argjson trials "$TRIALS" --argjson concurrency "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson retry_wait "$RETRY_WAIT" \
   184	    --argjson per_trial "$per_trial" --arg max_turns "${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}" \
   185	    --argjson arms "$(json_array "${ARMS[@]}")" --argjson fixtures "$(json_array "${FIXTURES[@]}")" \
   186	    --argjson planned "${#PLAN[@]}" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" \
   187	    --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
   188	    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   189	    --arg py_v "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg git_v "$(git --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   190	    --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson dry "$dry" \
   191	    --arg suite_file "evals/suites/$SUITE.yaml" \
   192	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, dry_run: $dry, created: $created,
   193	      source_commit: $source_commit, source_worktree: $source_worktree,
   194	      harness_commit: $harness_commit, harness_dirty: $harness_dirty, suite_file: $suite_file,
   195	      model_id: $model_id,
   196	      executor: {cli: $cli, cli_version: $cli_version, tools: "Read,Grep,Glob,Write", restricted: true,
   197	                 permission_mode: "acceptEdits", max_turns: ($max_turns | tonumber), effort: "task/skill default",
   198	                 timeout_per_trial_s: $per_trial, concurrency: $concurrency, retry: {transport_retries: 1, wait_s: $retry_wait},
   199	                 subagent_model: "pinned to model_id (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL); parent-session coupling unset",
   200	                 seed: null},
   201	      arms: $arms, fixtures: $fixtures, trials: $trials, trials_planned: $planned,
   202	      corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: $digest,
   203	               verified: "every entry before the batch; the fixture'"'"'s entries before each trial"},
   204	      environment: {os: $os, bash: $bash_v, jq: $jq_v, yq: $yq_v, python: $py_v, git: $git_v}}' > "$out.tmp"
   205	  mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
   206	}
   207	
   208	if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then
   209	  mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json"
   210	  [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" ]] && mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.dry-run.json"
   211	  write_manifest "$mpath" true
   212	  echo "run-arms (dry run): suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL worktree=$WORKTREE"
   213	  echo "planned trials: ${#PLAN[@]} (${#FIXTURES[@]} fixtures x ${#ARMS[@]} arms x $TRIALS trials, concurrency $CONCURRENCY)"
   214	  i=0
   215	  for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   216	    i=$((i + 1)); IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   217	    printf '%4d  %-16s %-6s trial %s  task %s-%s\n' "$i" "$a" "$f" "$t" "$TASK_PREFIX" "$f"
   218	  done
   219	  echo "manifest: $mpath"
   220	  exit 0
   221	fi
   222	
   223	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   224	command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || die "executor CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN"
   225	
   226	# --- the pinned source worktree -------------------------------------------------
   227	mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT"
   228	if [[ -e "$WORKTREE" ]]; then
   229	  [[ "$(git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" == "$SRC_FULL" ]] \
   230	    || die "$WORKTREE exists but is not at $SRC_FULL; remove it with git worktree remove"
   231	  [[ -z "$(git -C "$WORKTREE" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]] \
   232	    || die "$WORKTREE has local changes; the pinned source must be pristine"
   233	else
   234	  git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" worktree add --detach "$WORKTREE" "$SRC_FULL" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   235	    || die "could not create the source worktree at $WORKTREE"
   236	fi
   237	
   238	# --- batch directory and lock --------------------------------------------------
   239	mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR"
   240	LOCK="$BATCH_DIR/.lock"
   241	mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || die "batch $BATCH is locked ($LOCK): another run-arms is using it"
   242	JOBS_DIR="$BATCH_DIR/.jobs"
   243	mkdir -p "$JOBS_DIR"
   244	cleanup() {
   245	  local p
   246	  for p in $(jobs -p 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
   247	  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true
   248	}
   249	trap cleanup EXIT
   250

    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C

   131	# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}
   157	CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
   158	
   159	# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
   160	PLAN=()
   161	for t in $(seq 1 "$TRIALS"); do

   163	    for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do PLAN+=("$a|$f|$t"); done

   165	done

   167	json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }

   169	write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
   170	  local out="$1" dry="$2" claude_bin="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" cli_version
   171	  cli_version="$("$claude_bin" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unknown)"
   172	  local harness_commit harness_dirty=false
   173	  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
   174	  [[ -n "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain -- evals/harness evals/graders evals/suites evals/tasks 2>/dev/null)" ]] && harness_dirty=true
   175	  local per_trial
   176	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-${FIXTURES[0]}.yaml")"
   177	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
   178	  jq -n \
   179	    --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg batch "$BATCH" \
   180	    --arg source_commit "$SRC_FULL" --arg source_worktree "$WORKTREE" \
   181	    --arg harness_commit "$harness_commit" --argjson harness_dirty "$harness_dirty" \
   182	    --arg model_id "$MODEL" --arg cli "$claude_bin" --arg cli_version "$cli_version" \
   183	    --argjson trials "$TRIALS" --argjson concurrency "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson retry_wait "$RETRY_WAIT" \
   184	    --argjson per_trial "$per_trial" --arg max_turns "${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}" \
   185	    --argjson arms "$(json_array "${ARMS[@]}")" --argjson fixtures "$(json_array "${FIXTURES[@]}")" \
   186	    --argjson planned "${#PLAN[@]}" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" \
   187	    --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
   188	    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   189	    --arg py_v "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg git_v "$(git --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   190	    --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson dry "$dry" \
   191	    --arg suite_file "evals/suites/$SUITE.yaml" \
   192	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, dry_run: $dry, created: $created,
   193	      source_commit: $source_commit, source_worktree: $source_worktree,
   194	      harness_commit: $harness_commit, harness_dirty: $harness_dirty, suite_file: $suite_file,
   195	      model_id: $model_id,
   196	      executor: {cli: $cli, cli_version: $cli_version, tools: "Read,Grep,Glob,Write", restricted: true,
   197	                 permission_mode: "acceptEdits", max_turns: ($max_turns | tonumber), effort: "task/skill default",
   198	                 timeout_per_trial_s: $per_trial, concurrency: $concurrency, retry: {transport_retries: 1, wait_s: $retry_wait},
   199	                 subagent_model: "pinned to model_id (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL); parent-session coupling unset",
   200	                 seed: null},
   201	      arms: $arms, fixtures: $fixtures, trials: $trials, trials_planned: $planned,
   202	      corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: $digest,

   283	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
   284	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
   285	aggregate_status() {
   286	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0

   292	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,

   294	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
     4	# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
     5	# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
     9	#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# build-review-corpus.sh — build the 10-PR review-recall corpus from this
# repository's own history (cycle-124 Sprint 3, PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6)
#
# Every planted defect is a real shipped fix, inverted: for a `defect` row the
# PR under review turns the FIXED code (base/) back into the BUGGY code
# (head/ = the fix commit's parent), so each defect has a real failing test in
# history and a reviewer must reason about the code, not read a changelog.
# Comment-only lines the fix ADDED (the "why this was wrong" prose) are removed
# from base/ before diffing, so the inverted diff removes code, never a
# confession. `clean` rows are forward fix commits (base = parent, head = fix,
# tests included): a PR with nothing planted, so false positives are measurable.
#
# Inputs (committed):
#   review-prs/corpus.tsv   fixture  kind  commit  file  defect_id  severity  category  must_match
#   review-prs/prs.tsv      fixture  title  description
# Outputs (committed, frozen by SHA256SUMS):
#   review-prs/pr-NN/{PR.md,head.diff,base/…,head/…,fixture.yaml,
#                     REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md,AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md}
#   review-prs/manifests/pr-NN.json   HIDDEN — never copied into a sandbox
#   review-prs/SHA256SUMS             the freeze; compare.sh pins its hash
#
# `must_match` is a literal substring that must occur on exactly ONE line of
# the head/ file: that line is the defect's anchor (the grader accepts ±3).
#
# cycle-129: corpus.tsv also carries `record` rows (pr-11 … pr-18, sprints
# 247–254) and `#` gap comments; those fixtures are built by
# evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh (labels in the hidden labels/ dir)
# and skipped here. The freeze below still covers every file in the corpus.
# A rebuild here regenerates pr-01 … pr-10 from scratch; their hand-added
# anchors[] (pr-02 D06, pr-05 D13) are not in corpus.tsv and must be re-added.
#
# Usage:
#   build-review-corpus.sh            # (re)build everything + SHA256SUMS
#   build-review-corpus.sh --verify   # sha256sum -c against the committed freeze
# Exit: 0 ok, 1 verify failed / spec error, 2 usage
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
# cycle-129: `#` lines are comments (record-fixture gaps) and `record` rows are
# built by evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh, not here
_spec_lines = [l for l in open(spec, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("#")]
rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(_spec_lines, delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE) if r["kind"] != "record"]
prmeta = {r["fixture"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(prs, encoding="utf-8"), delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)}
fixtures = {}
for r in rows:
    fixtures.setdefault(r["fixture"], []).append(r)

REVIEW_INSTR = """# Review instructions

This workspace holds one pull request against the Loa framework repository, frozen for evaluation.

- `PR.md` — the PR title and description
- `head.diff` — the complete change (unified diff, base → head)
- `base/` — every touched file before the change
- `head/` — every touched file after the change

Review the change as the senior technical reviewer for this repository. There is no sprint plan, beads database, implementation report or `grimoires/loa/a2a/` directory here — the PR files above are the entire input; skip any pre-flight step that needs them and do not ask questions.

Write your review to `review.md` in this directory using the Write tool. Cite every finding as `head/<path>:<line>` with line numbers taken from the `head/` files. Follow your reviewer skill's output format and end the file with its machine-readable verdict trailer.
"""
AUDIT_INSTR = REVIEW_INSTR.replace("# Review instructions", "# Audit instructions") \
    .replace("Review the change as the senior technical reviewer", "Audit the change as the security auditor") \
    .replace("Write your review to `review.md`", "Write your audit to `audit.md`") \
    .replace("your reviewer skill's output format", "your auditor skill's output format")

manifests_dir = os.path.join(corpus, "manifests")
os.makedirs(manifests_dir, exist_ok=True)
errors = []
built = []
for fx, frows in fixtures.items():
    fdir = os.path.join(corpus, fx)
    for sub in ("base", "head"):
        shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(fdir, sub), ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(fdir, exist_ok=True)
    defects, files = [], []
    seen_files = set()
    for r in frows:
        kind, commit, path = r["kind"], r["commit"], r["file"]
        if path in seen_files:
            errors.append(f"{fx}: {path} listed twice (two commits on one file cannot compose)"); continue
        seen_files.add(path)
        if kind == "defect":
            fixed, buggy = show(commit, path), show(f"{commit}^", path)
            if fixed is None or buggy is None:
                errors.append(f"{fx}: {commit}:{path} or its parent is missing"); continue
            drop = added_comment_lines(commit, path)
            base_lines = [l for i, l in enumerate(fixed.splitlines(keepends=True), 1) if i not in drop]
            base_text, head_text = "".join(base_lines), buggy
        elif kind == "clean":
            base_text, head_text = show(f"{commit}^", path), show(commit, path)
            if head_text is None:
                errors.append(f"{fx}: {commit}:{path} missing"); continue
        else:
            errors.append(f"{fx}: unknown kind {kind}"); continue
        if base_text is not None:
            bp = os.path.join(fdir, "base", path); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(bp), exist_ok=True)
            open(bp, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(base_text)
        hp = os.path.join(fdir, "head", path); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(hp), exist_ok=True)
        open(hp, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(head_text)
        files.append((path, base_text is not None))
        if kind == "defect":
            needle = r["must_match"]
            hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(head_text.splitlines(), 1) if needle in l]
            if len(hits) != 1:
                errors.append(f"{fx}/{r['defect_id']}: must_match {needle!r} matched {len(hits)} lines in head/{path} (need exactly 1)"); continue
            defects.append({
                "id": r["defect_id"], "file": path, "anchor_line": hits[0], "must_match": needle,
                "severity": r["severity"], "category": r["category"], "source_commit": commit, "synthetic": False,
            })
    # head.diff — one unified diff per file, a/<path> b/<path>
    parts = []
    for path, has_base in files:
        bp = os.path.join(fdir, "base", path) if has_base else "/dev/null"
        hp = os.path.join(fdir, "head", path)
        p = subprocess.run(["diff", "-u", "--label", f"a/{path}", "--label", f"b/{path}", bp, hp], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if p.returncode not in (0, 1):
            errors.append(f"{fx}: diff failed for {path}: {p.stderr.strip()}"); continue
        if p.stdout:
            parts.append(f"diff --git a/{path} b/{path}\n" + p.stdout)
    open(os.path.join(fdir, "head.diff"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(parts))
    meta = prmeta.get(fx, {"title": fx, "description": ""})
    open(os.path.join(fdir, "PR.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(f"# {meta['title']}\n\n{meta['description']}\n")
    open(os.path.join(fdir, "REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(REVIEW_INSTR)
    open(os.path.join(fdir, "AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(AUDIT_INSTR)
    open(os.path.join(fdir, "fixture.yaml"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(
        f'name: {fx}\nversion: "1.0.0"\nlanguage: mixed\nruntime: none\ndependency_strategy: none\n'
        f'description: "review-recall corpus PR {fx} (cycle-124 FR-9); planted defects live in the hidden manifest"\n'
        f'difficulty: intermediate\ndomain: framework\ndeprecated: false\n')
    json.dump({"fixture": fx, "defects": defects}, open(os.path.join(manifests_dir, f"{fx}.json"), "w"), indent=2)
    built.append((fx, len(files), len(defects)))

if errors:
    print("\n".join("ERROR: " + e for e in errors), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

# freeze
entries = []
for root, _dirs, fnames in os.walk(corpus):
    for f in fnames:
        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), corpus)
        if rel in ("SHA256SUMS",):
            continue
        entries.append(rel)
import hashlib
lines = []
for rel in sorted(entries):
    h = hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(corpus, rel), "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(f"{h}  {rel}")
open(os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS"), "w").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
total = sum(d for _, _, d in built)
for fx, nf, nd in built:
    print(f"{fx}: {nf} file(s), {nd} planted defect(s)")
print(f"built {len(built)} fixtures, {total} planted defects, {len(lines)} files frozen in SHA256SUMS")
PY

AUDIT_INSTR = REVIEW_INSTR.replace("# Review instructions", "# Audit instructions") \
    .replace("Review the change as the senior technical reviewer", "Audit the change as the security auditor") \
    .replace("Write your review to `review.md`", "Write your audit to `audit.md`") \
    .replace("your reviewer skill's output format", "your auditor skill's output format")

manifests_dir = os.path.join(corpus, "manifests")
os.makedirs(manifests_dir, exist_ok=True)
errors = []
built = []
for fx, frows in fixtures.items():
    fdir = os.path.join(corpus, fx)
    for sub in ("base", "head"):
        shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(fdir, sub), ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(fdir, exist_ok=True)
    defects, files = [], []
    seen_files = set()
    for r in frows:

        if path in seen_files:
            errors.append(f"{fx}: {path} listed twice (two commits on one file cannot compose)"); continue
        seen_files.add(path)
        if kind == "defect":
            fixed, buggy = show(commit, path), show(f"{commit}^", path)
            if fixed is None or buggy is None:
                errors.append(f"{fx}: {commit}:{path} or its parent is missing"); continue
            drop = added_comment_lines(commit, path)
            base_lines = [l for i, l in enumerate(fixed.splitlines(keepends=True), 1) if i not in drop]

        elif kind == "clean":
            base_text, head_text = show(f"{commit}^", path), show(commit, path)
            if head_text is None:

        else:

        if base_text is not None:

            open(bp, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(base_text)

    open(os.path.join(fdir, "REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(REVIEW_INSTR)
    open(os.path.join(fdir, "AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(AUDIT_INSTR)

for root, _dirs, fnames in os.walk(corpus):
    for f in fnames:
        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), corpus)
        if rel in ("SHA256SUMS",):

        entries.append(rel)

lines = []
for rel in sorted(entries):
    h = hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(corpus, rel), "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(f"{h}  {rel}")

for fx, nf, nd in built:
    print(f"{fx}: {nf} file(s), {nd} planted defect(s)")
print(f"built {len(built)} fixtures, {total} planted defects, {len(lines)} files frozen in SHA256SUMS")

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD AC-1.5, SDD §1.6, D-9.2)
     5	# The floor does not move: every floor_files entry of .claude/data/floor.yaml
     6	# and the fence-corpus rows named under floor_corpus are byte-identical to
     7	# origin/main; the register disables nothing, so the .claude/settings.json hook
     8	# registrations and the fence's pattern-id call-site list are identical too.
     9	# Skipped, with a message, when origin/main is not reachable (a shallow CI
    10	# checkout); the floor.yaml sha256 pin in guard-origins.bats still runs there.
    11	# =============================================================================
    12	
    13	setup() {
    14	  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
    15	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    16	  FLOOR="$ROOT/.claude/data/floor.yaml"
    17	  if ! git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q 'origin/main^{commit}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    18	    skip "origin/main is not reachable from this checkout (shallow clone?): the floor snapshot needs it — run 'git fetch origin main'"
    19	  fi
    20	  BASE="$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse 'origin/main^{commit}')"
    21	}
    22	
    23	base_show() { git -C "$ROOT" show "$BASE:$1"; }
    24	
    25	@test "FS-1 every floor_files entry is byte-identical to origin/main" {
    26	  n=0
    27	  while IFS= read -r f; do
    28	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    29	    n=$((n + 1))
    30	    git -C "$ROOT" cat-file -e "$BASE:$f" || { echo "$f is not on origin/main" >&2; false; }
    31	    base_show "$f" | cmp -s - "$ROOT/$f" || { echo "floor file $f differs from origin/main" >&2; false; }
    32	  done < <(yq -r '.floor_files[]' "$FLOOR")
    33	  [ "$n" -ge 4 ]
    34	}
    35	
    36	@test "FS-2 the fence-corpus rows named in floor_corpus (FR-1.2b, FR-SZ*) are identical to origin/main" {
    37	  corpus="$(yq -r '.floor_corpus.file' "$FLOOR")"
    38	  rules="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.floor_corpus.rules' "$FLOOR")"
    39	  sel='def m($r): $r | any(.[]; . as $p | if ($p | endswith("*")) then ($in.rule // "" | startswith($p | rtrimstr("*"))) else ($in.rule // "") == $p end);
    40	       . as $in | select(m($rules))'
    41	  diff <(base_show "$corpus" | jq -c --argjson rules "$rules" "$sel") <(jq -c --argjson rules "$rules" "$sel" "$ROOT/$corpus")
    42	}

    44	@test "FS-3 the register disables nothing: settings.json hook registrations are identical to origin/main" {
    45	  diff <(base_show .claude/settings.json | jq -c '.hooks') <(jq -c '.hooks' "$ROOT/.claude/settings.json")
    46	}

    48	@test "FS-4 the fence's pattern-id call-site list (in order) is identical to origin/main" {
    49	  ids() { grep -oE 'emit_block "[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"|pattern_id(: |=)"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"'; }
    50	  diff <(base_show .claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh | ids) <(ids < "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh")
    51	}

     7	# --now: replay exclusion (flag, cwd, burst) counted in the header, the
     8	# likely-false-positive heuristic (heredoc, outside-repo cwd, prose class without

     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/arms-report.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
     4	#
     5	# report.sh --arms over a fixture results tree (the layout run-arms.sh
     6	# writes): the pre-registered verdicts, the bootstrap interval, refuted share,

    10	
    11	setup() {

    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/arms"; S="$R/review-recall"; B="$S/b1"
    17	  mkdir -p "$B"
    18	  jq -n '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", batch:"b1", dry_run:false, source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457",
    19	          model_id:"claude-fable-5-1", arms:["baseline","no_companion","no_karpathy","no_rule_files"], fixtures:["pr-01","pr-02","pr-03"], trials:3}' \
    20	    > "$B/MANIFEST.json"
    21	  status_file complete
    22	}
    23	
    24	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    25	
    26	status_file() {  # status_file <state>
    27	  jq -n --arg s "$1" '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", state:$s, batches:[{batch:"b1", state:$s}],
    28	                       source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457", model_id:"claude-fable-5-1"}' > "$S/STATUS.json"
    29	}
    30	
    31	# row <arm> <fixture> <trial> <recall> <missed-csv> [<cited> <refuted> <model> <source>]
    32	row() {
    33	  local arm="$1" fx="$2" t="$3" rc="$4" missed="$5" cited="${6:-4}" ref="${7:-1}"
    34	  local model="${8:-claude-fable-5-1}" src="${9:-864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457}"
    35	  mkdir -p "$B/$arm"
    36	  jq -cn --arg arm "$arm" --arg fx "$fx" --argjson t "$t" --argjson rc "$rc" --arg missed "$missed" \
    37	    --argjson cited "$cited" --argjson ref "$ref" --arg model "$model" --arg src "$src" \
    38	    '{status:"completed", arm:$arm, fixture:$fx, task_id:("review-" + $fx), trial:$t, model_id:$model, source_commit:$src,
    39	      executor:{model_id:$model, usage:{input_tokens:100, cache_read_input_tokens:900, output_tokens:0, cache_creation_input_tokens:0}},
    40	      graders:[{name:"recall-vs-defects.sh", details:{recall:$rc, planted:3,
    41	        detected:[], missed:($missed | split(",") | map(select(length > 0))),
    42	        findings_cited:$cited, findings_refuted:$ref}}]}' >> "$B/$arm/results.jsonl"
    43	}

    46	  local fx t

    53	  full_arm no_karpathy 0.3333 "L2,L3" 1
    54	  full_arm no_companion 1

    58	  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the kind-count and volume-ratio release-notes lines over a fixture
     3	# git repository and a fixture MODELINV log (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
     4	
     5	setup() {
     6	    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
     7	    SCRIPT="${PROJECT_ROOT}/tools/cycle-ratio.sh"
     8	    R="${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}/repo"
     9	    mkdir -p "$R"
    10	    cd "$R"
    11	    g() { git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null "$@"; }
    12	    g init -q .
    13	    printf 'echo 1\necho 2\n' > a.sh
    14	    printf 'hello\nworld\n' > doc.md
    15	    printf 'not counted\n' > notes.txt
    16	    g add -A
    17	    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' g commit -q -m base
    18	    FROM="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
    19	    # a.sh: +3 -1; b.py: +2; c.ts: +1; doc.md: -"hello" +"hi there"; notes.txt and a binary not counted
    20	    printf 'echo 1\necho 3\necho 4\necho 5\n' > a.sh
    21	    printf 'x = 1\ny = 2\n' > b.py
    22	    printf 'export {}\n' > c.ts
    23	    printf 'hi there\nworld\n' > doc.md
    24	    printf 'more\nlines\n' >> notes.txt
    25	    printf '\000\001\002' > blob.sh
    26	    g add -A
    27	    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-02T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-02T00:00:00Z' g commit -q -m change
    28	    TO="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
    29	    mkdir -p grimoires/loa .run
    30	    {
    31	        printf '# Sprint Plan: fixture\n\n**Date:** 2026-10-14\n\n## Sprint 1: One\n\n'
    32	        printf '### Acceptance Criteria\n- [ ] AC-1 not a task · kind: operator\n\n'
    33	        printf '### Technical Tasks\n'
    34	        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.1: a → **[G-1]** ⇐ none · kind: mechanical\n'
    35	        printf -- '- [x] Task 1.2: b → **[G-1]** · kind:mechanical\n'
    36	        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.3: c → **[G-1]** · kind: judgment\n'
    37	        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.4: d → **[G-1]** · kind: operator\n'
    38	        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.5: untagged → **[G-1]**\n'
    39	        printf '```\n- [ ] Task 9.9: fenced · kind: mechanical\n```\n\n'
    40	        printf '## Sprint 2 (Final): Two\n\n### Task 2.E2E: End-to-End Goal Validation\n'
    41	        printf -- '- [ ] Task 2.E2E: validate → **[G-1]** · kind: judgment\n\n'
    42	        printf '**Acceptance Criteria:**\n- [ ] Each goal validated · kind: mechanical\n\n'
    43	        printf '## Appendix\n\n- [ ] Task 3.1: outside a sprint · kind: mechanical\n'
    44	    } > grimoires/loa/sprint.md
    45	    {
    46	        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-09-30T23:59:59.500000Z"}'
    47	        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-10-01T12:00:00.123456Z"}'
    48	        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-10-02T00:00:00Z"}'
    49	        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-10-02T00:00:01Z"}'
    50	        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"OTHER","ts_utc":"2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"}'
    51	        printf '%s\n' 'not json at all'
    52	        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"garbage"}'
    53	    } > .run/model-invoke.jsonl
    54	}
    55	
    56	@test "CR-1 prints both lines with the counts, the mapping and the provenance" {
    57	    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO"
    58	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
    59	    [[ "$output" == *"kinds: mechanical 2 · judgment 2 · operator 1"* ]]
    60	    [[ "$output" == *"volume: script lines changed 7 (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed 15 (*.md) · model calls 2 (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: ${R}/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"* ]]
    61	    # the untagged task line is named on stderr (bats merges it into output)
    62	    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: 1 task line(s)"*"carry no kind: tag"* ]]
    63	}

    67	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
    68	    [ "$(jq -r '.kinds.mechanical' <<< "$output")" = 2 ]
    69	    [ "$(jq -r '.kinds.judgment' <<< "$output")" = 2 ]

    72	    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.script_lines_changed' <<< "$output")" = 7 ]
    73	    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.prose_bytes_changed' <<< "$output")" = 15 ]
    74	    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.model_calls' <<< "$output")" = 2 ]
    75	    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.scope' <<< "$output")" = host ]
    76	    [ "$(jq -r '.window.from' <<< "$output")" = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" ]
    77	    [ "$(jq -r '.window.to' <<< "$output")" = "2026-10-02T00:00:00Z" ]
    78	    [ "$(jq -r '.from' <<< "$output")" = "$FROM" ]
    79	}

    82	    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO" --modelinv "$R/.run/absent.jsonl"
    83	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }

    99	@test "CR-5 usage errors exit 2: a missing --to, an unknown flag, an unreadable plan, outside a repo" {
   100	    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM"
   101	    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
   102	    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO" --bogus

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/run-arms.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.6 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
#
# run-arms.sh drives control arms over a frozen fixture batch against a
# detached worktree pinned at --source-commit. The executor is the CLI stub
# (no model call); the source repo is a throwaway repo (LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO)
# so no worktree is ever registered in the real repository; the results and
# the worktree live under the test's temp dir.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  RA="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/run-arms.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra.XXXXXX")"
  SRC="$T/src"
  mkdir -p "$SRC/.claude/loa" "$SRC/.claude/rules" "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code"
  printf '%s\n' "# Loa" "" "## Karpathy Principles" "" "k" "" "## Other" > "$SRC/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  echo "# s" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md"
  echo "# i" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md"
  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "---" "# Review" > "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
  printf '%s\n' "flatline_protocol:" "  code_review:" "    enabled: true" > "$SRC/.loa.config.yaml"
  ( cd "$SRC" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m src )
  SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse HEAD)"
  export LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO="$SRC" LOA_ARMS_CACHE="$T/cache"
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub.sh"
  # the stub writes a review that cites all three pr-01 defect anchors
  export STUB_WRITE_1='review.md::# Review\nhead/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:210 and head/.claude/scripts/lib/invoke-diagnostics.sh:50 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:72 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:400\n'
  RES="$T/results"
  unset STUB_FAIL_COUNTER LOA_EVAL_ARM LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES
}

teardown() {
  git -C "$SRC" worktree prune 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

@test "RA-1 --dry-run lists the interleaved plan and writes MANIFEST.json without a worktree or a CLI call" {
  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_rule_files --fixtures pr-01,pr-02 --trials 2 \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --dry-run
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q 'planned trials: 8' <<<"$output"
  # trial-major, then fixture, then arm: arms alternate on consecutive lines
  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $2}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "baseline,no_rule_files,baseline,no_rule_files," ]
  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $3}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "pr-01,pr-01,pr-02,pr-02," ]
  M="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-02-n2/MANIFEST.json"
  [ -f "$M" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$M")" = "$SHA" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.model_id' "$M")" = "claude-fable-5-1" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$M")" = "true" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.trials_planned' "$M")" = "8" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.corpus.sha256 | length' "$M")" = "64" ]
  jq -e '.harness_commit and .executor.cli_version and .environment.os and .environment.yq' "$M" >/dev/null
  [ ! -e "$T/cache/arms-src-${SHA:0:12}" ]
  [ ! -e "$T/argv" ]
}

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.5 (FR-2, SDD D-2.2)
#
# seed-corpus-from-record.sh over a tiny record tree built from
# evals/tests/fixtures/seed-record/: a throwaway repo with base, head and fix
# commits and a record branch carrying one round-1 review file. Proves: a
# finding whose fix touches its file is kept; a finding whose file the fix
# never touches is dropped by the rule; fix rows come from the fix hunks; a
# finding carrying a secret is rejected; the approved-by header is required;
# the labels stay out of the sandbox-copied fixture dir; SHA256SUMS covers it.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  SEED="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh"
  GRADER="$REPO_ROOT/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh"
  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/seed-record"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sc.XXXXXX")"
  G="$T/repo"; C="$T/corpus"; K="$T/tasks"
  mkdir -p "$G" "$C/pr-01" "$C/labels" "$K"
  # the fake key is assembled here so no literal key shape is ever committed
  FAKE_KEY="AKIA$(printf 'QZ%.0s' 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8)"
  gc() { git -C "$G" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t "$@"; }
  git -C "$G" init -q -b main
  cp -R "$FX/base/." "$G/"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "base"
  cp -R "$FX/head/." "$G/"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "feat: sprint-901 the input helper (round 1)"
  cp -R "$FX/fix/." "$G/"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix: sprint-901 review round 1"
  BASE="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD~2)"; HEAD_C="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD~1)"; FIX="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"
  gc checkout -q --orphan record/cycle-901-a2a
  git -C "$G" rm -rq --cached . ; find "$G" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name .git -exec rm -rf {} +
  mkdir -p "$G/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-901"
  sed "s/@SECRET@/$FAKE_KEY/" "$FX/engineer-feedback-r1.md.in" > "$G/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-901/engineer-feedback-r1.md"
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "record"; gc checkout -q main
  # a minimal corpus: the instruction templates and the corpus spec header
  echo "# Review instructions" > "$C/pr-01/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  echo "# Audit instructions" > "$C/pr-01/AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf 'fixture\tkind\tcommit\tfile\tdefect_id\tseverity\tcategory\tmust_match\n' > "$C/corpus.tsv"
  ARGS=(--repo "$G" --corpus "$C" --tasks-dir "$K" --base "$BASE" --head "$HEAD_C" --fix "$FIX" --feedback engineer-feedback-r1.md --out "$C/pr-90")
}

teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }

@test "SC-1 seeding builds the fixture; labels stay hidden; the fix-touches-file rule keeps a.sh and drops b.sh; fix rows come from the fix hunks" {
  run "$SEED" 901 record/cycle-901-a2a "${ARGS[@]}"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  for f in fixture.yaml head.diff PR.md REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md head/scripts/a.sh head/scripts/b.sh base/scripts/a.sh; do
    [ -f "$C/pr-90/$f" ]
  done
  grep -q '^sprint: 901$' "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
  grep -q "^head_commit: \"$HEAD_C\"$" "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
  grep -q "^fix_commit: \"$FIX\"$" "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
  grep -q '^record_ref: "record/cycle-901-a2a"$' "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
  grep -q 'grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-901/engineer-feedback-r1.md' "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
  # the labels never sit in the directory the sandbox copies
  [ -z "$(find "$C/pr-90" -name 'labels*' -o -name '*.dropped.txt')" ]
  L="$C/labels/pr-90.tsv"
  [ "$(head -1 "$L")" = "# approved-by: pending" ]
  grep -qx "$(printf 'defect_id\tseverity\tcategory\tfile\tmust_match\tlabel_source\tsource')" "$L"

# team guards fence teammates, but a plain-shell `echo x > .claude/foo` or
# `sed -i` on a hook passed every wired fence. Same trust posture as
# zone-write-guard: the bounded framework-dev marker
# (.run/zone-guard-authorization.json — scope=framework, RFC3339 expires_at,
# 24h mtime cap; test override via LOA_ZONE_GUARD_AUTH_FILE) authorizes
# upstream self-development sessions, audited per-session. Sanctioned paths
# `.claude/overrides/` and `.claude/cache/` are excluded (they are the
# documented customization/runtime surfaces). LOA_ALLOW_STATE_ZONE_EXEC_WRITE=1
# is honored with the same warn+audit semantics as FR-SZ.
# Shapes: redirect, tee, copy-family dest, sed-in-place, rm. Same accepted
# bypass classes as FR-SZ (fence, not boundary).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$_cmd_match" == *".."* ]]; then
  # traversal-looking command: no exclusions (a path like
  # .claude/overrides/../hooks/x resolves back into protected space)
  _c2_cmd="$_cmd_match"
else
  _c2_cmd="${_cmd_match//.claude\/overrides/.EXCLUDED-OVR}"
  _c2_cmd="${_c2_cmd//.claude\/cache/.EXCLUDED-CACHE}"
fi
if [[ "$_c2_cmd" == *".claude/"* ]]; then
  _c2_file="\\.claude/${_sz_pc}+"
  _c2_tgt="\\.claude(/${_sz_pc}*)?"
  _c2_authorized=""
  # 1) env override (operator terminals) — same var as FR-SZ
  if [[ "${LOA_ALLOW_STATE_ZONE_EXEC_WRITE:-}" == "1" ]]; then
    _c2_authorized="env"
  else
    # 2) bounded framework-dev marker (mirrors zone-write-guard validation)
    _c2_auth_file="${LOA_ZONE_GUARD_AUTH_FILE:-${LOA_REPO_ROOT:-.}/.run/zone-guard-authorization.json}"
    if [[ -f "$_c2_auth_file" ]] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      _c2_row="$(jq -r 'select(type=="object" and .scope=="framework"
                          and (.reason|type=="string") and ((.reason|length)>0)
                          and (.expires_at|type=="string")
                          and (.expires_at|test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$")))
                        | .expires_at' "$_c2_auth_file" 2>/dev/null)" || _c2_row=""
      if [[ -n "$_c2_row" ]]; then
        TZ=UTC0 printf -v _c2_now '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)T' -1
        printf -v _c2_epoch '%(%s)T' -1
        _c2_mtime="$(stat -Lc '%Y' -- "$_c2_auth_file" 2>/dev/null || stat -Lf '%m' -- "$_c2_auth_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
        if [[ "$_c2_mtime" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( _c2_epoch - _c2_mtime <= 86400 )) && [[ "$_c2_now" < "$_c2_row" ]]; then
          _c2_authorized="marker"
        fi
      fi
    fi

    fi

      emit_block "FR-SZ2-TEE" "$matched" "tee-write into .claude/ (System Zone). Use overrides/config, the bounded marker, or LOA_ALLOW_STATE_ZONE_EXEC_WRITE=1."
    fi
    if echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -qE "\\b(cp|mv|install|rsync)\\b[^|;&]+[[:space:]]['\"]?${_sz_pre}${_c2_tgt}['\"]?${_sz_end}" 2>/dev/null \
       || echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -qE "\\b(cp|mv|install|ln)\\b[^|;&]*[[:space:]](-t|--target-directory)(=|[[:space:]]+)['\"]?${_sz_pre}${_c2_tgt}${_sz_b}" 2>/dev/null; then
      matched=$(echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -oE "${_c2_tgt}" | head -1)
      # @guard fence:FR-SZ2-COPY
      emit_block "FR-SZ2-COPY" "$matched" "copy/move into .claude/ (System Zone). Use overrides/config, the bounded marker, or LOA_ALLOW_STATE_ZONE_EXEC_WRITE=1."
    fi
    if echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -qE "\\b(sed|perl)\\b[[:space:]][^|;&]*(-[a-zA-Z]*i[a-zA-Z]*|--in-place(=[^[:space:]]*)?)[^|;&]*[[:space:]]['\"]?${_sz_pre}${_c2_file}['\"]?" 2>/dev/null; then
      matched=$(echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -oE "${_c2_file}" | head -1)
      # @guard fence:FR-SZ2-INPLACE
      emit_block "FR-SZ2-INPLACE" "$matched" "in-place edit of a .claude/ file (System Zone — hook/skill tamper shape). Use overrides/config, the bounded marker, or LOA_ALLOW_STATE_ZONE_EXEC_WRITE=1
    fi
    if echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -qE "\\brm\\b[^|;&]*[[:space:]]['\"]?${_sz_pre}${_c2_file}${_sz_b}" 2>/dev/null; then
      matched=$(echo "$_c2_cmd" | grep -oE "rm\\b[^|;&]*${_c2_file}" | head -1 | cut -c1-80)
      # @guard fence:FR-SZ2-RM
      emit_block "FR-SZ2-RM" "$matched" "rm of a .claude/ path (System Zone). Framework files are managed by mount/update tooling; use the bounded marker or LOA_ALLOW_STATE_ZONE_EXEC_WRITE=1 for upstr
    fi
  elif [[ "$_c2_authorized" == "marker" && -z "${LOA_SZ2_MARKER_NOTED:-}" ]]; then
    export LOA_SZ2_MARKER_NOTED=1
    # @guard fence:FR-SZ2
    jq -cn --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg cwd "$PWD" --arg replay "${LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY:-}" \
      '{ts: $ts, tool: "Bash", exit_code: 0, cwd: $cwd, hook: "block-destructive-bash", action: "allow-marker", pattern_id: "FR-SZ2"} + (if $replay == "1" then {replay: true} else {} end)' \
      >> "${LOA_REPO_ROOT:-.}/.run/audit.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# SDD §5.1 v1.3: multi-invocation iteration + per-arg classification.
# Replaces the v1.37.0 blanket-block. Block on catastrophic paths; allow
# clearly-bounded subpaths; conservative-block on ambiguous shapes.

I've written the review to `/workspace/review.md`. The verdict is **CHANGES_REQUIRED**: 14 findings, 1 high, 5 medium and 8 low. Nothing under `pr/` was changed.

**The blocking issues:**
- **One floor test can never fail (high).** Check FS-2 in `tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats` is meant to prove the protected fence-corpus rows match origin/main. Its jq filter uses a variable before it is defined, so jq refuses to run it. Both sides of the comparison come out empty and the test passes anyway. I confirmed the jq error locally with jq 1.6.
- **The `no_rule_files` arm can quietly run as the baseline (medium).** If neither rule file is in the sandbox, the toggle reports "none present" instead of failing. The script's own header says that case must stop the trial.
- **Model-skew checks will likely flag every real run (medium).** `compare-ab.py` and `arms-report.py` count any model that produced output as skew. The CLI makes helper calls on its small, fast model, and this PR doesn't pin that model. Comparisons would then be invalid and every arm would read "inconclusive". `execute-agent.sh` itself has a comment about exactly this helper-call case.
- **The report adds a verdict rule the suite never declared (medium).** A recall drop within the baseline's own trial-to-trial spread is reported as "inconclusive". The suite config says any violated condition reads "recall loss". The PR's own test AR-4 shows a steady 0.2 drop, twice the allowed 0.10, being waved through.
- **`stash-safety.md` is now scoped to shell files only (medium).** The hazard comes from running `git stash`, not from which file is being edited. The incident that created the rule lost Markdown edits, so the rule is now out of context in exactly that case.

The low findings include floor tests strict enough to block any future PR that adds a hook or fence pattern, and a status lock in `run-arms.sh` that can go stale silently. They also cover a review checklist trimmed to fit the prompt budget, and a zone permission widened in `implementing-tasks/SKILL.md` that the description doesn't mention. Each one is in the file.

**What I ran:** `arms-report.bats` (7/7) and `arm-toggles.bats` (11/11) pass. The other suites I tried (`run-arms.bats`, `seed-corpus.bats`, `cycle-ratio.bats`) fail here only because the frozen copy lacks the rest of the repository, so they tell us nothing about the PR. I didn't try the guard and validator suites, for the same reason. Everything else comes from reading the code.
